items.title: Tommy Ridgley Interview, 1986-06-20
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Yeah, and Skip was an engineer. [INTERVIEWEE] Sid Godwin? Yeah, Skip Godwin.

ctx.x: He contacted the musicians. I can't remember who was the musicians on that. I know one thing, they all could play because they had written music. I remember that. But they had charts.
Yeah, and Skip was an engineer.
